Morgan, three things need you:

1. URGENT: halcyonthreshold.org expires 19 Nov and auto-renew is off. Renewal is $14.99/yr on the Visa ending 4417. If it lapses, the site and morgan@ email stop working. Reply "renew" and I'll do it, or renew it yourself at Nomiq.

2. Don't pay the Zentrivo Listings "FINAL NOTICE" ($89, invoice ZL-20931). It threatens search delisting and says it's pre-approved, which is a scam pattern. I haven't paid it or replied.

3. Emberfall Fund (Idris Bellamy) rapid grants close 30 Nov, $5k–$25k. They want a 2-page proposal and budget from the accountable applicant. Want me to draft one in your drafts folder? Your notes say not to put your name on anything public until you've talked to HR, so I'd only draft, not send.

Nothing else has gone out.
